status.main_product: Smart utility and smart city software products (mPower suite)
status.scope_reason: The company provides integrated smart city and infrastructure solutions, including smart metering, city command centers, and urban technology software suites under its own brand name.
status.evidence: According to Ministry of Corporate Affairs filings retrieved via Tofler, Fluentgrid Limited is currently active and headquartered in Visakhapatnam, providing turnkey digital solutions for utilities and smart cities.

claims.claim: The company reports that its technology handles asset and network intelligence by integrating multiple external data layers, including IoT, GIS, SCADA, and enterprise application frameworks, to establish unified 2D and 3D visual environments for smart city deployment.
claims.note: Establishment of unified 2D and 3D visual environments for smart city deployment

claims.claim: The company reports that its city operations platforms, such as Fluentgrid Actilligence and Fluentgrid COC, integrate IoT, GIS, SCADA, and CCTV data streams to enable real-time operational views and simulated environments for smart cities.

The company reports that its Fluentgrid Actilligence and Integrated Operations Center platforms support multi-source data integration by aggregating information from IoT devices, GIS, SCADA, CCTV, and enterprise systems into a unified command-and-control environment.

The company's Actilligence platform powers the Integrated Command & Control Centre (ICCC) for Lucknow Smart City Limited (LSCL), integrating solid waste management, environmental sensors, public Wi-Fi, and water SCADA.

The company deployed the Integrated Command, Control, Communication & Computing Centre (IC4) for Cochin Smart Mission Limited (CSML) in Kochi, which acts as the city operations center for disaster management and real-time governance.

Independent credit rating assessments verified that Fluentgrid Limited recorded a total operating income of ₹202.15 crore, an EBITDA of ₹47.31 crore, and a profit after tax (PAT) of ₹14.98 crore for the financial year ending March 31, 2025.
claims.note: EBITDA of ₹47.31 crore and profit after tax (PAT) of ₹14.98 crore for FY25

claims.claim: Independent credit ratings confirmed that the company maintained a strong recurring order book of ₹706.86 crore as of April 1, 2025, which included projects for its core advanced metering infrastructure (AMI), customer relationship management (CRM), and customer information systems (CIS) solutions.

Third-party research documents that Fluentgrid provided an integrated city management solution (a Customer Information System integrated with CRM tools) for the Lodha Group's Palava Smart City in India.
claims.source: Fluentgrid Official Case Study (Integrated city management solution for Lodha Group’s Palava Smart City)

claims.claim: The company reports a strategic cloud architecture partnership with Amazon Web Services (AWS) active since 2021 to support energy, utilities, and smart city digital transformations through its platforms.
The company demonstrated its Actilligence platform at the Smart City Expo 2025 in Kuala Lumpur as an ecosystem partner featured at the joint booth of Intel and Dell Technologies.
claims.source: Intel and Dell Technologies Press Blog & Fluentgrid Event Announcements (Smart City Expo Kuala Lumpur 2025)
